title: Deterministic fail-closed PIT admissibility predicate
why_selected: The repository names this work itself. portfolio_automation/northstar/pit.py lines 13-14 state: 'This is the future anti-lookahead authority: Phase 0C will enforce evidence.known_at <= experiment.as_of.' That is the smallest useful atomic foundation task, it is required by the 0C exit gate (lookahead-audited PIT reads), and every other gateway capability (identity, provenance, revision safety) depends on having an admissibility decision to attach to.

justification: Pure contract-level predicate over the existing 0B PointInTime kernel. Adds no persistence, no vendor coupling, no production wiring, no authority. Directly serves the authoritative 0C exit gate.

acceptance_criteria: known_at == as_of is ADMITTED (boundary is inclusive, matching '<= as_of')
known_at one microsecond after as_of is REJECTED
known_at is None with basis 'unknown' is REJECTED with a distinct reason
a naive (tz-unaware) as_of is REJECTED with a distinct reason
known_at earlier than published_at is REJECTED as incoherent timing
decisions are reasons from a closed set, not free text
identical inputs always produce identical decisions
importing the module performs no I/O and reads no clock
escalation_conditions: canonical PIT semantics turn out to be ambiguous for a required rule -> ABSTAIN
a rule would require inventing semantics the 0B kernel does not define -> record NEXT_TASK_CANDIDATE and exclude it, do not guess
any requirement would need vendor, persistence or production scope -> STOP
taskspec.goal: Provide the EvidenceGateway's single deterministic decision: given a canonical PointInTime and an as-of instant, is this evidence admissible for a read as of that instant? Enforce the anti-lookahead authority named by portfolio_automation/northstar/pit.py: known_at <= as_of. Fail closed when timing is unknown or internally incoherent, and return an explicit machine-readable reason for every decision.
requirements: admissible iff known_at is present AND known_at <= as_of
known_at absent (basis 'unknown') is NOT admissible — fail closed, never treated as admissible-by-default
known_at strictly after as_of is NOT admissible (the core anti-lookahead rule)
as_of must be timezone-aware; a naive as_of is refused rather than coerced
every decision carries an explicit machine-readable reason code
the predicate is pure and deterministic: no clock read, no I/O, no network
0B canonical contracts are consumed, never modified
no vendor schema appears in the interface
